class.name: anywheresoftware.b4a.mtw.clipboard.Clipboard
class.comment: Allows easily using clipboard functionalities in Basic4Android.

method.name: GetText
method.comment: Gets the contents of the clipboard.

method.name: ClearText
method.comment:
Clears the contents of the clipboard.
This function doesn't return anything. Use the hasText function if you want to verify whether the clipboard contents were cleared successfully.

method.name: SetText
method.comment: Sets a specific text as the new clipboard contents.

method.name: SetText2
method.comment:
Sets a specific text as the new clipboard contents.
This function supports setting the clipboard content description on Android API level 11+ (Android 3.0+). On older Android versions, it just discard unsupported attributes and sets only the text.

method.name: HasText
method.comment:
This function checks whether the clipboard contains any text at all. It doesn't check whether whether a specific text is inside.
Returns False if the clipboard has been cleared before.

root.comment: Allows easily using clipboard functionalities in Basic4Android.
root.author: mtw
